ui.label: Dietary preferences
ui.instruction: Tick any dietary preferences or restrictions you would like us to consider when making food recommendations.

roles.exclusion: Hard filter. Conflicting foods should not be recommended.
roles.eligibility: Eligibility filter. Only suitable foods should be presented.
roles.preference: Soft ranking preference. It should influence ranking without overriding stronger health relevance unless configured to do so.
roles.safety_context: Context flag. Apply appropriate eligibility/safety rules rather than treating it as a health score.

recommendationRules: Dietary preferences must be applied after health relevance has been calculated but before the final food recommendation list is presented.
A dietary exclusion should remove a conflicting food rather than merely reduce its score.
Preference-style selections such as High Fibre or High Protein should influence ranking rather than act as exclusions.
Dietary preferences must not alter the nine body-system health scores.
Dietary preferences must not create health outcomes.
The same preference framework should be available to food recommendations and, where product ingredient data supports it, product filtering.

futureExpansion.note: New preferences can be added without changing the questionnaire architecture.
